inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. inputs.modified_text: This sounds like the familiar arrangement: illegal mining carries on, a company KTR says belongs to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is implicated, and the Congress government is accused of looking away. That kind of inaction is hard to dismiss as an ordinary oversight when powerful interests may benefit. The accusation may be only a fragment, but the rush to manage the story instead of confront the allegation is exactly what makes the whole setup look protected.
